Name: Simple HD Icons
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#F2C879]Simple HD Icons[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[heading][color=#8FDAC0]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/color][/heading]

For PC. Requires Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.1.10 or newer.

[heading][color=#8FDAC0]🎨 Familiar Items, Detailed HD Artwork[/color][/heading]

Give familiar Stardew items detailed HD artwork while retaining their recognizable shapes and colours. Includes crops and seeds, forage, resources, minerals, fish, food, artisan goods, tools, equipment, hats, and mapped machines and decorations.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54137/54137-1792352556-1566441252.png[/img][/center]

[heading][color=#8FDAC0]🍷 Ingredient-Specific Products[/color][/heading]

Supported wine, jelly, pickles, bait and other ingredient-specific products use artwork matched to their ingredient. Supported smoked fish use the full fish artwork with a toasted finish, without an ingredient badge.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54137/54137-1792352556-195354013.png[/img][/center]

[heading][color=#8FDAC0]🌱 Supported World Artwork[/color][/heading]

Includes mapped crop growth stages and craftable states, natural objects, five giant crops and eight skill/stat symbols. Dropped items use the world-artwork settings. This is not a replacement for every game texture: worn hats, tool-swing animations, furniture, trees, fruit trees, tea bushes, fences, paths and placed crab-pot animations retain their current artwork.

[heading][color=#8FDAC0]⚙️ Choose What Changes[/color][/heading]

Ten categories each have separate Inventory & Menus and World Artwork switches. You can use original inventory icons alongside HD crops in the field, or make the opposite choice. Natural world objects, giant crops and skill/stat symbols have their own switches. Disable the master switch to use your original or installed replacement artwork.

[heading][color=#9ACAF7]🧩 Retextures & Other Mods[/color][/heading]

Supported icons fit inventory and toolbar slots while retaining the game’s quality stars and stack counts. Changed or unsupported source artwork keeps its loaded replacement. If some objects stay unchanged, check their category’s Inventory & Menus switch and whether another mod replaces those textures. For reports, include the affected item names and a SMAPI log; SMAPI debug logs include per-atlas HD coverage. Custom item artwork and unsupported world forms are not automatically redrawn. Generic Mod Config Menu is optional; Content Patcher is not required.

[heading][color=#C8B0F4]📦 Installation & Updating[/color][/heading]

Install SMAPI, then extract the SimpleHDIcons folder into Mods. Configure it through Generic Mod Config Menu or config.json. When updating from Simple Icons HD or an earlier Faithful Icons edition, close the game, keep config.json, remove the old mod folder, and put config.json inside the new SimpleHDIcons folder. Keep only one edition installed. Remove the mod folder to uninstall.

[heading][color=#C8B0F4]🌍 Languages & Credits[/color][/heading]

Includes English, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, German, French, Japanese, Italian and Hungarian language files. Some newer settings use English fallback. Artwork, code and translations were created with AI assistance. Gallery boards combine isolated native menu renders at equal scale; they are not live gameplay captures.

[heading][color=#F2C879]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/color][/heading]

Please share the mod version, game/SMAPI version and platform, what happened versus what you expected, and steps to reproduce. Include a [url=https://smapi.io/log]shared SMAPI log[/url] and a screenshot or short video when helpful. Suggestions are welcome: explain the change you would like and how it would help.
